summary: hiker on Lake Como Road reported chest pains and lightheadedness at 13:40; AVSAR paged the team plus two 4x4 drivers and Alamosa EMS staged an ambulance at Incident Command; two truck teams reached him at 15:59 and evacuated him via 4x4 to IC, where EMS evaluated him; all teams back by 17:08; no hospital transport documented
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer Search and Rescue; Alamosa County Sheriff's Office; Alamosa EMS
